title: Listening & Speaking for Beginning English Language Learners
provenanceNotes: Self-declared high-beginning integrated-skills book; chapter pages carry CC BY 4.0 (LibreTexts metadata license:ccby/licenseversion:40). Chapter 1 'Greetings and Introductions' was inspected in full: strong Preview → Listen → Comprehension → Speaking staging, but its content mixes countries/spelling/email/phone beyond the Lesson 001 target and every speaking activity requires classmates. Role in SE Lesson 001: lesson-structure reference only — no text copied; its listenings are embedded players (not redistributable audio).
